Name: Nyapu Sandy for Rose in the Sand by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Nyapu Sandy for Rose in the Sand[/center]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. 

I've been wanting to add this mod to my game, but the other Nyapu mods clashed with it. Now I've created a mod to fix that problem. I've updated and changed some of Sandy's expressions to better fit this mod. Enjoy~!


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30976]Roses In The Sand (A Romancable Sandy Expansion)[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder
3. ﻿IF YOU HAVE ANY OF THE SEASONAL NYAPU PORTRAITS TURN OFF SANDY WITHIN EACH OF THE NYAPU SEASONAL MODS IN GMCM! (Vanilla and SVE)

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder. You'll need to turn off any of Sandy's Seasonal Nyapu Portraits you have installed through GMCM. (You only need to shut off the NYAPU  SEASONAL versions. The regular seasonal cute shouldn't clash, I hope. )

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 
[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/163169958]w8AwA8w[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.
Thank you Poltergeister for creating so many amazing mods and allowing anyone to edit them. 
[b]
[i][b]What am I working on?:[/b][/i]
[/b][i]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile. [/i][/i]
